original_description: Design and build interactive collectible cards from your characters, products, or artwork. Parallax Card guides separate background and transparent character artwork, readable live typography, pointer-reactive 3D depth, foil highlights, and optional flip and layer views. Includes adaptable React, CSS, and motion-hook templates with keyboard controls, reduced-motion support, and integration guidance. Use your own artwork or generate new art with an available image-generation tool. Artwork binaries are not included.
summary_ja: キャラクターや作品から、傾きや光に反応する立体的なカードを作る。
limitations: 画像素材は付属せず、手持ちの画像または利用可能な画像生成ツールを使うと説明。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
